{{nowrap|(San Fernando, Trinidad and Tobago)}} | draft_year = 2026 | draft_round = 2 | draft_pick = 60 | draft_team = [[Washington Wizards]] | career_start = 2021 | years1 = 2021–2023 | team1 = [[Baloncesto Fuenlabrada|Fuenlabrada]] | years2 = [[2023–24 NBA G League season|2023–2024]] | team2 = [[Mexico City Capitanes]] | years3 = 2024–2026 | team3 = [[South East Melbourne Phoenix]] | years4 = 2026–present | team4 = [[Cairns Taipans]] | highlights = }} '''Malique Lewis''' (born 10 November 2004) is a Trinidadian professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Cairns Taipans]] of the Australian [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] (NBL). After playing in Spain and the [[NBA G League]] between 2021 and 2024, he played in the NBL as a ''Next Star'' with the [[South East Melbourne Phoenix]] between 2024 and 2026. In the [[2026 NBA draft]], Lewis was selected with the 60th final overall pick by the [[Washington Wizards]], and traded to the [[Milwaukee Bucks]]. He later returned to the NBL and joined the Taipans for the 2026–27 season. ==Early life== Lewis was born in [[Trinidad and Tobago]].{{cite web |title=Malique Lewis |url=https://www.acb.com/jugador/temporada-a-temporada/id/30001261 |website=[[ACB.com]] |access-date=23 April 2025 |language=es}} His hometown is [[San Fernando, Trinidad and Tobago|San Fernando]].{{cite news |title=Get to Know Your New NBL25 Phoenix Players: Malique Lewis |url=https://www.semphoenix.com.au/news/get-to-know-your-new-nbl25-phoenix-players-malique-lewis |access-date=23 April 2025 |work=South East Melbourne Phoenix {{!}} Official NBL Website |date=20 July 2024}} He grew up playing [[Association football|football]].{{cite news |title=Next Star takes step towards NBA goal |url=https://nbl.com.au/news/next-star-takes-step-towards-nba-goal |access-date=23 April 2025 |work=NBL.com.au |date=23 April 2025 |language=en}} Lewis started to play basketball while he attended Pleasantville Secondary School in San Fernando.{{cite web |title=From Plaisance Park to the NBA: Malique Lewis Shares Journey with SporTT Board |url=https://sportt-tt.com/2026/08/18/from-plaisance-park-to-the-nba-malique-lewis-shares-journey-with-sportt-board/ |website=SporTT |access-date=31 August 2026 |date=18 August 2026}} ==Professional career== ===Fuenlabrada (2021–2023)=== As a 16-year-old, Lewis moved to Spain to play for [[Baloncesto Fuenlabrada|Fuenlabrada]] in the [[Liga ACB]], where he went up from 2.3 minutes in three appearances during the [[2021–22 ACB season|2021–22 season]] to 19 games in [[2022–23 ACB season|2022–23]] for almost 18 minutes per game and 4.8 points and 3.5 rebounds. In May 2023, he produced the fourth-highest-scoring game in ACB history by a player aged 18 or younger with 24 points against [[Obradoiro CAB|Obradoiro]].{{cite news |title=Next Star Malique Lewis Signs with Phoenix |url=https://www.semphoenix.com.au/news/next-star-malique-lewis-signs-with-phoenix |access-date=23 April 2025 |work=South East Melbourne Phoenix {{!}} Official NBL Website |date=11 July 2024}} ===Mexico City Capitanes (2023–2024)=== Lewis joined the [[Mexico City Capitanes]] of the [[NBA G League]] for the [[2023–24 NBA G League season|2023–24 season]], where he played in 50 games and averaged 8.3 points and 5.8 rebounds in over 25 minutes per game. ===South East Melbourne Phoenix (2024–2026)=== In July 2024, Lewis signed with the [[South East Melbourne Phoenix]] of the Australian [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] (NBL) as part of the league's ''Next Stars'' program.{{cite news |title=NBA draft prospect Lewis joins NBL's Phoenix |url=https://www.espn.com.au/nbl/story/_/id/40535473 |access-date=23 April 2025 |work=ESPN.com |date=11 July 2024 |language=en|agency=AAP}}{{cite news |last=Jackson |first=Andrew |title='Tremendous upside': {{sic|Car|ribean|nolink=yes}} NBA prospect Malique Lewis unveiled as latest NBL Next Star |url=https://www.foxsports.com.au/basketball/nbl/nbl-2024-malique-lewis-signs-with-south-east-melbourne-phoenix-next-stars-program-full-list-of-nbl-next-stars-for-202425-season/news-story/74bbfbb62426b261157efe25e425035b |access-date=23 April 2025 |work=foxsports.com.au |date=11 July 2024}} He became an important piece for the Phoenix over the course of the [[2024–25 NBL season|2024–25 season]], becoming one of the premier defenders on the team.{{cite news |last=Badkin |first=Liam |title=NBL25 Next Star review - Malique Lewis |url=https://central.rookieme.com/basketball/nbl25-next-star-review-malique-lewis/ |access-date=23 April 2025 |work=Basketball Rookie Me Central |date=11 March 2025}} He scored a season-high 15 points in November 2024, and for the season averaged 6.8 points, 4.1 rebounds and 1.0 assists per game. In April 2025, Lewis declared for the [[2025 NBA draft]].{{cite news |title=NBL Next Stars declare for 2025 NBA Draft {{!}} Basketball.com.au |url=https://www.basketball.com.au/news/nbl-next-stars-izan-almansa-and-malique-lewis-declare-for-2025-nba-draft |access-date=23 April 2025 |work=basketball.com.au |date=23 April 2025 |language=en}} On 11 June 2025, he withdrew his name from the draft and subsequently returned to the South East Melbourne Phoenix for the [[2025–26 NBL season]].{{cite news |title=Next stop, NBL26: Lewis runs it back with Phoenix |url=https://nbl.com.au/news/next-stop-nbl26-lewis-runs-it-back-with-phoenix |access-date=11 June 2025 |work=NBL.com.au |date=11 June 2025 |language=en}} On 6 November 2025, he scored a career-high 23 points in a 103–102 win over the [[Tasmania JackJumpers]].{{cite news |title=Phoenix prevail in Launceston shootout |url=https://www.nbl.com.au/news/phoenix-prevail-in-launceston-shootout |access-date=8 November 2025 |work=NBL.com.au |date=6 November 2025 |language=en}}{{cite news |last=Badkin |first=Liam |title=Lewis makes the leap in breakout performance |url=https://central.rookieme.com/basketball/lewis-makes-the-leap-in-breakout-performance/ |access-date=8 November 2025 |work=Basketball Rookie Me Central |date=7 November 2025}} Later that month, he began suffering from [[pneumothorax]], a condition that the affects lungs.{{cite news |title=United star's new setback; Tassie sweat on skipper's season — NBL Casualty Ward |url=https://www.foxsports.com.au/basketball/nbl/nbl-2025-latest-injury-and-team-news-casualty-ward-shea-ili-suffers-setback-will-magnay/news-story/21ea288d98c6960f6dbe2d64a06f2d05 |access-date=26 December 2025 |work=Fox Sports |date=21 November 2025 |language=en}} He missed a month of action due to pneumothorax and a hamstring injury.{{cite news |title=DREWITT'S BULBS MATCH PREVIEW: Phoenix head to Hobart after nine-day break |url=https://www.semphoenix.com.au/news/drewitts-bulbs-match-preview-phoenix-head-to-hobart-after-nine-day-break |access-date=30 December 2025 |work=South East Melbourne Phoenix {{!}} Official NBL Website |date=28 December 2025}} On June 24, 2026, Lewis was selected by the [[Washington Wizards]] with the 60th overall and final pick in the [[2026 NBA draft]]. He was then immediately traded to the [[Milwaukee Bucks]].{{cite news |last=Owczarski |first=Jim |title=Milwaukee Bucks acquire second-round pick, draft Malique Lewis |url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/nba/bucks/2026/06/24/milwaukee-bucks-acquire-2026-second-round-pick-draft-malique-lewis/90686702007/ |work=Journal Sentinel |date=24 June 2026 |access-date=25 June 2026}} ===Cairns Taipans (2026–present)=== On 25 August 2026, Lewis signed with the [[Cairns Taipans]] on a two-year deal, with the second year being a club option, returning to the NBL for a second stint.{{cite news |title=Cairns complete: Malique Lewis rounds out the roster {{!}} Cairns Taipans |url=https://www.taipans.com/news/cairns-complete-malique-lewis-rounds-out-the-roster |access-date=25 August 2026 |work=taipans.com |date=25 August 2026 |language=en}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://www.nba.com/player/1641831/malique-lewis/bio NBA profile] *[https://nbl.com.au/players/malique-lewis NBL profile] *[https://www.acb.com/jugador/temporada-a-temporada/id/30001261 ACB profile] {{Cairns Taipans current roster}} {{2026 NBA draft}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Lewis, Malique}} [[Category:2004 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Baloncesto Fuenlabrada players]] [[Category:Expatriate basketball people in Australia]] [[Category:Expatriate basketball people in Mexico]] [[Category:Expatriate basketball people in Spain]] [[Category:Mexico City Capitanes players]] [[Category:Small forwards]] [[Category:South East Melbourne Phoenix players]] [[Category:Sportspeople from San Fernando, Trinidad and Tobago]] [[Category:Trinidad and Tobago men's basketball players]] [[Category:Trinidad and Tobago expatriate basketball people]] [[Category:Trinidad and Tobago expatriates in Spain]] [[Category:Trinidad and Tobago expatriate sportspeople in Australia]] [[Category:Trinidad and Tobago expatriate sportspeople in Mexico]] [[Category:Washington Wizards draft picks]]
